evidence.activity: Company-wide training programs for staff at every career level: online learning through Thermo Fisher University, manager training and a Global Leadership Program for executives
evidence.quote: We provide multiple programs at all career levels, from online learning for all colleagues through Thermo Fisher University, to focused trainings for managers at various experience levels, to our Global Leadership Program for executives.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.quote: We also support our colleagues’ career advancement through our tuition reimbursement program.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Talent pipeline of summer internships, university relations and a Graduate Leadership Development Program, presented as recruiting channels
evidence.quote: From our colleague referral program, summer internships, university relations, to our Graduate Leadership Development Program, we continue to build strong internal and external talent channels.

community.criterion: level 2: framed as a recruiting and talent pipeline, not as external education; no reach disclosed

evidence.activity: Annual Employee Involvement Survey that tracks an Inclusion index
evidence.quote: We then compile the feedback to measure our progress using three key indices: Leadership, Involvement and Inclusion.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1: measures inclusion only; no specific barrier-removing practice is described

evidence.activity: Company's own research and development programs
evidence.quote: Our R&D programs are aligned with the needs of each major business and are critical to maintaining our competitive position and supporting our long-term growth strategy.
evidence.section: Item 1 > New Products and Research and Development

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: the company's own innovation, not enabling founders or small businesses

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers scientific instruments, reagents, diagnostics and pharma services, and shows no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: the evidence shows only employee development (training programs, tuition reimbursement, internship and graduate talent channels), so Community is capped at 2.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: the substantial Human Capital section offers only general fairness language and an inclusion survey index, with no employee networks, accessibility or customer-access programs.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the filing shows only the company's own innovation and R&D, with no service or program enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: The targeted Item 7 excerpt was empty, so no MD&A paragraphs matched the theme terms. The regional headcount split (59,000 Americas, 22,000 Asia-Pacific, 44,000 EMEA) describes international operations, not demographics, and was not scored. 'Collaborations with leading research institutions' are R&D partnerships, and 'uniqueness of design' and copyright licensing of graphic images and software are traps; none were counted. 'Small-molecule' refers to pharmaceuticals, not small business. Internships and university relations are framed as recruiting channels, so they are tagged as employee development, not external education. The Impact Program cancer-care benefit is an employee health benefit with no theme fit. A sustainability report second look is not triggered because Community and Cross-cultural coverage are both sufficient.
